fixed: The DHI Nginx image now explicitly runs the EduLog bootstrap, writes the active Nginx configuration, and listens on the exposed application ports.

fixed: Dashboard and incomplete-report tasks now require assignment, explicit teacher attendance, and an effective class-role notification policy; absence and deny decisions take precedence.
Policy-aware incomplete-report queries now fail closed instead of exposing the broader attended-teacher scope.

Notification eligibility now requires an effective class teacher assignment on the occurrence date; generic RBAC assignments cannot replace a class role, and classes with no eligible role or policy notify nobody.
Policy-aware notification responses now bypass client caches, use private no-store response headers, and clear stale incomplete-report data when the endpoint fails.
Automatic class report creation now includes regular enrollments only.
A persisted present and fully completed report on the highest-sequence lesson now completes a regular enrollment without chapter or progress-letter checks.
Classroom actions remain visible on touch devices; student profiles, report calendars, and wrapped class schedules now stay within narrow layouts.
RBAC compatibility views now use invoker security, the role trigger has a fixed search path, and duplicate legacy indexes were removed.
The container release workflow now runs tests, production type-checking, and the application build before publishing.
tests: Added regression coverage for yuan's 2026-07-25 assistant deny, effective-date notification eligibility, no-policy fail-closed behavior, no-store responses, regular-only report creation, final-lesson completion, responsive layouts, calendar synchronization, and database lint fixes.
